features: Wireless Connectivity: The Key10 Combo offers a seamless wireless experience with advanced 2.4 GHz technology, ensuring a strong, interference-free connection.

Wrist-Rest Comfort: Designed for long work sessions, the keyboard includes a built-in wrist rest that provides enhanced support, helping reduce wrist strain and fatigue during extended typing periods.

Smartphone Holder: Stay connected and multitask effortlessly with the integrated smartphone holder on the keyboard. This feature keeps your phone within easy view, making it perfect for video calls, notifications, or keeping up with messages while you work.

Noise-Free Typing: Enjoy a quiet, distraction-free workspace with the Key 10 Combo’s noiseless keycaps, designed for smooth and silent typing, making it ideal for shared workspaces or late-night tasks.
Multimedia Hot Keys: Control your music and media with ease using dedicated multimedia hot keys. Adjust volume, play, pause, mute, and switch tracks instantly without interrupting your workflow.

High-Precision Mouse: The included wireless mouse features an adjustable DPI button for customizable sensitivity. Switch between multiple levels of precision to suit various tasks, whether browsing, working on spreadsheets, or gaming.
description: Portronics Key10 Combo Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Set with Wrist Rest, Multimedia Hotkeys, USB Receiver, Adjustable DPI, AI Assistance, Long Key Life & Click Life for PC & Laptop (Grey)
